v1.3.3 Hotfix
🐛 Typewriter Skip Toggle: Unchecking "Skip typewriter" on a Story node now saves the disabled state correctly. Closing and reopening the Interaction Editor no longer turns the option back on.

announcement.title: 🌸 Visual Novel Maker v1.3.3
announcement.content:
Visual Novel Maker v1.3.3 fixes the per-node typewriter skip toggle.

  • Unchecking "Skip typewriter" now remains disabled after closing and reopening the Interaction Editor.
